# Investigation / RFC: Site Standards & Design Quality Audit Mechanism for Existing Sites (Audit & Modernize Pipeline) ## 1. Problem Statement & Background Over time, this starter repository (`emdash-site-starter`) continuously evolves: * **Evolving Starter Standards:** We introduce improved architectural patterns (e.g. native Astro image delivery backport, schema budget caps of ≤ 50 columns, EmDash live editorial proxies, PhotoSwipe gallery enhancements, Tailwind v4 `@theme` tokens, Art Direction Records, and `DESIGN.md` interoperability). * **Evolving Model Capabilities & Agent Harnesses:** Modern LLM models (e.g. Gemini 2.5, Claude 3.7, GPT-4.5) and agent harnesses (Antigravity 2.0, Codex) have significantly superior reasoning, visual critique, and spatial awareness compared to models used when earlier sites were generated. Currently, we have several downstream client sites created from this template (e.g. `legacy-migration`, `gallery-backport`, etc.). However: * **No Unified Audit Mechanism Exists:** We currently have isolated individual scripts (`check-schema-budget.mjs`, `check-native-images.mjs`, `check-art-direction.mjs`, `sync-site-skills.mjs --check`), but no cohesive, end-to-end mechanism to audit an existing site against modern starter standards. * **Audits Must Not Be Mere Static Reports:** If an audit only produces a list of grievances, it becomes shelfware. The audit must function as a complete **Audit & Modernization Pipeline (Diagnose ➔ Prescribe ➔ Remediate)** that empowers an agent or developer to systematically backport all modern architectural, visual, and interaction improvements to older sites. --- ## 2. Objectives of the Audit & Modernize Pipeline The mechanism must allow an engineer or an agent to open any existing site repository built from this starter and execute two continuous stages: 1. **The Diagnostic Pass (Audit):** Identify all skill drift, architectural debt, code anti-patterns, and visual slop. 2. **The Remediation Pass (Modernization):** Provide executable, prioritized recipes to backport new starter features, upgrade micro-interactions, calibrate typography, and integrate modern tooling. --- ## 3. The Three-Phase Workflow: Diagnose ➔ Prescribe ➔ Remediate ``` ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ PHASE 1: AUTOMATED SCAN & DIAGNOSTIC AUDIT │ ├────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┤ │ • Skill & dependency drift │ • Schema column budget (≤ 50) │ │ • Native image delivery check │ • EmDash live proxy check │ │ • Anti-pattern linter (
, fr)│ • Vision model visual critique│ └────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ PHASE 2: THE EXECUTABLE REMEDIATION PLAN │ │ (Saved to `audit/site-standards-audit-.md`) │ ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ • P0: Critical/Breaking (Schema violations, broken images) │ │ • P1: Architectural Parity (Astro images, live CMS proxies) │ │ • P2: Design Craft & Physics (Osmo interactions, trim, HUD) │ └────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ PHASE 3: GUIDED REMEDIATION & RETROFITTING │ │ (Invoked via `npm run audit:modernize`) │ ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ 1. Synchronize skills (`npm run sync:site-skills`) │ │ 2. Backport missing components (`_styleguide`, TweaksBar HUD) │ │ 3. Retrofit Osmo CSS micro-interactions to buttons & cards │ │ 4. Calibrate typography bounding box trim (`text-box-trim`) │ │ 5. Auto-extract root `DESIGN.md` for OpenDesign/Stitch parity │ │ 6. Verify with visual regression tests (`npm run test:visual`) │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` --- ## 4. Concrete Retrofits: Upgrading Older Sites When the modernization pass runs on an older client site, it systematically executes the following upgrades: ### A. Micro-Interactions & Hover Physics (The Osmo/CodePen Pattern) * **The Legacy Problem:** Older sites usually have flat, generic button hovers (e.g. `opacity: 0.8` or simple color flips). * **The Retrofit:** The remediation recipe upgrades buttons, cards, and navigation links with production-grade CSS physics: * Shutter fills, directional sweeps, and subtle magnetic hovers. * **Crucial Rule:** The interaction is bound 100% to the site's existing semantic theme tokens (`--color-action`, `--color-surface`, `--color-page`), ensuring it functions seamlessly across Light, Dark, and Brand surfaces with zero external runtime bloat. ### B. Motion Layer & Scroll Mechanics * Retrofits smooth scrolling (Lenis) and sticky pinned section reveals where appropriate, transforming the perceived quality of the site. ### C. Typography Metric Calibration (`text-box-trim` / Trim-Top) * Calibrates font bounding boxes to eliminate the "ghost line-height margin" above headings, ensuring headings snap cleanly to layout grids and containers. ### D. EmDash Canvas Ownership & Live Edit Proxies * Audits templates to find where CMS fields (titles, introductions, callouts) are rendered as static text. * Refactors elements to spread `{...field.proxy}`, unlocking frontend in-context editing in the EmDash admin. ### E. Native Astro Image Pipeline Modernization * Migrates legacy unoptimized `` tags or custom manual thumbnail scripts to native Astro `` / `` and `ResponsiveImage.astro` / `EditorialImage.astro`. ### F. Auto-Extracting Root `DESIGN.md` * Runs the `impeccable document` or Stitch utility on the existing site. * Automatically extracts the site's current colors, typography scale, and border radii into a root `DESIGN.md`, instantly making the legacy site compatible with modern visual tools like **OpenDesign** and **Google Stitch**. ### G. Developer HUD & Living Styleguide Retrofit * Injects the living styleguide route (`src/pages/_styleguide.astro`) and the upgraded `` HUD with the `G` (Column Grid Guide) and `O` (Screenshot Diff Overlay) hotkeys into the project. --- ## 5. Detailed Specification of Audit Vectors (The Diagnostic Pass) 1. **Skill & Upstream Drift Analysis:** Check `.emdash/site-skills.json` and `.emdash/upstream-skills.json` against canonical commits (`sync:site-skills --check` and `sync:emdash-skills`). 2. **Architectural & Schema Compliance:** Verify collection schema columns remain ≤ 50 physical columns (`check-schema-budget.mjs`); verify rich text wrapped in `.flow`. 3. **Code Anti-Pattern Linter:** Detect layout `
` tags in headings, unconstrained `1fr` grid tracks (missing `minmax(0, 1fr)`), and raw hex colors bypassing theme tokens. 4. **Visual Craft & Responsive Quality:** Vision model analysis of desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px) screenshots to spot visual slop, awkward responsive wraps, and non-text contrast issues. --- ## 6. Implementation Architecture: CLI + Agent Playbook * **CLI Scanner (`scripts/audit-site.mjs` / `npm run audit:site`):** Executes all deterministic checks and outputs a machine-readable summary. * **Agent Modernization Skill (`.agents/skills/site-standards-audit/`):** * Reads the audit scorecard. * Guides the agent through executing the remediation recipes in prioritized order. * Validates every change against headless visual regression tests (`npm run test:visual`). --- ## 7. Questions for Discussion & Second Opinion 1. **Automated vs. Interactive Remediation:** Which retrofits can be fully automated via AST/codemods (e.g. adding `minmax(0, 1fr)`, updating package versions), and which require agent reasoning (e.g. injecting Osmo micro-interactions or rewriting heading `
` tags)? 2. **Safe Backport Verification:** How do we ensure that backporting the native image pipeline or EmDash proxies does not disrupt live production Cloudflare D1/R2 databases or content already entered by clients? 3. **Auditing Cadence:** Should downstream client sites be audited automatically on a schedule (e.g. via GitHub Actions monthly), or triggered manually when a major starter milestone is released?
title: Investigation / RFC: Site Standards & Design Quality Audit Mechanism for Existing Sites
